scope: Source behavior and synthetic tests; not production activation

code_capabilities.live_model_availability: unverified; no provider catalog or completion calls made
code_capabilities.default_fallback: Explicitly labelled deterministic calculations and narration
code_capabilities.optional_failover: One explicit directional operator-approved edge; network, timeout or server failure only
code_capabilities.admission_control: Existing durable owner/day credits, bounded reservation and fail-closed storage errors
code_capabilities.diagnostic_payload: Fixed categories and aggregate counters only; no response body, prompt, reply, key or URL

production_acceptance.managed_identity: Code integrated; provider callback, delivery and owner session acceptance pending
production_acceptance.durable_database: Startup verifies schema; production backup, approved migration and secure DATABASE_URL configuration pending
production_acceptance.background_worker: Separate non-activating daemon candidate; container and hosted acceptance tracked independently
production_acceptance.external_models: Not activated or live-tested by this change

known_limits: No bundled catalog can certify current model retirement, account access or pricing.
A generic 404 may mean an endpoint or resource is missing; it does not prove retirement.
Unrecognized provider error codes remain generic rather than interpreted from potentially sensitive free text.
Configured model IDs and legacy default IDs may age; an operator must verify and approve a replacement.
Deterministic fallback does not fulfill work that genuinely requires an unavailable model.
Per-process failure telemetry resets on process restart; durable admission credits do not.

documented_legacy_defaults.replacement: Requires separate operator selection; no automatic switch

documented_legacy_defaults.status_at_review: Listed in provider public catalog with metered pricing
